### FUTURE WEATHER GENERATOR ###
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PURPOSE:
This JAVA package is a future weather generator according to scenarios of the 
IPCC. It uses the 'morphing' shift and stretch methods to adjust EPW files
to match projected GCM models simulations in different timeframes.

The CMIP6 experiments were the basis for the 6th IPCC report.
The original EPW file will be morphed to match the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways
SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, and SSP5-8.5 for the 2050 and 2080 timeframes
for typical, warmer and colder years.
The EPW reference meteorological period ranges between 1985 and 2014.

In addition, it can preprocess the original EPW to include Urban Heat Island
effect from World averages of max and min air temperatures between 2004 and2018.


More information at https://adai.pt/future-weather-generator/.
